3 years; jumped bail; +4 years for bail jumping (total ~7)

Custody was interrupted by release pending appeal. The Militant (June 1, 1959, page 4) reports that Thompson returned to prison on May 20, 1959 to complete the contempt sentence after the Supreme Court declined review. Political Affairs (March 1961, page 22) describes him as recently released and on conditional release. The original 1949 sentencing date therefore cannot serve as the start of uninterrupted imprisonment through 1960. The earlier custody interval and exact final release date require further verification.
